title: How web performance is measured and what the targets are
question: Do we measure page performance with synthetic tests (PageSpeed Insights, as the PRD proposes), with real-user monitoring (as built), or both? Which pages are monitored, what are the agreed targets, and who owns the alerts?
context: The PRD proposes PageSpeed Insights with FCP, LCP and TTI. The running service collects real-user vitals and alerts Slack on code thresholds (LCP 4 s, INP 500 ms, TTFB 1.8 s, CLS 0.25; viewer pages LCP 6 s) (OPS-REQ-012, OPS-REQ-013).
options: Both, with targets agreed per page group
